title: Hermitian indices and factorization of selfadjoint operators on a Kreĭn space
summary: The hermitian indices of a selfadjoint operator $C$ on a Kreĭn space $\mathcal H$ are defined as geometric measures of positivity and negativity of the operator. A different pair of indices arises in the Bognár-Krámli factorization of $C$, which writes $C$ as a product $AA^*$ where $A$ acts on a Kreĭn space $\mathcal A$ into $\mathcal H$ and has zero kernel; the new indices are the positive and negative indices of $\mathcal A$. Such factorizations are far from unique. When $\mathcal H$ is separable, it is known that the two notions of indices always coincide, and this has applications to…
